Marta L.: Quick sync — CloudPartner marketplace co-marketing. Partner asks for: joint webinar (tech+biz), a benchmark narrative comparing Hosted vs Dedicated, a marketplace listing + quickstart, and inbound lead routing into SFDC. Need owners, shipping dates, and an e2e test plan.
Priya K.: I can own the webinar. Proposed format: 30m tech demo + 15m Q&A. Target week of May 18, prefer Tue/Thu 11am PT.
Jonah S.: I’ll take the benchmark narrative. Need the test matrix: models, sequence lengths, batching configs, and cost calc. Ralph — can you share perf artifacts?
Ralph G.: Will upload perf CSV + notes. Key caveats: Dedicated numbers assume KV cache warm for steady-state; Hosted has broader tail latency. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (placeholder). Also note marketplace payload limit ~2MB.
Sam W.: On inbound routing: marketplace -> webhook -> partner-routing service -> SFDC. We should map partner_id + utm params and set lead owner queue to 'mp-partner-inbound'. Who can handle webhook secret/token?
Lucy H.: I’ll draft the landing page hero + bullet props. Plan: 1-line problem, 3 bullets (latency, cost, reliability), partner callout + CTA. Mockups by Thu.
ops-bot: CloudPartner requested webhook subscription. Please confirm endpoint and auth method.
Marta L.: Owners: Webinar (Priya), Benchmark (Jonah), Landing page (Lucy), Lead routing (Sam), Engineering support (Ralph). Deadlines: lock webinar assets by 1759883200. Ops e2e test scheduled by 1759880400.
Jonah S.: Benchmark plan: run comparisons for quantized vs fp16, batching on/off, and end-to-end cost per 1k tokens. Will produce charts: latency vs throughput, cost curves, and sample request/response logs.
Ralph G.: Note on test harness: use the sample app (k8s job) to simulate 50/200/500 qps. Warm caches for 2 minutes before collecting metrics. Also add a fallback model tag to the config to avoid marketplace throttles.
Priya K.: Speaker ask — want partner Eng + partner PM. Marta can you intro? Also will need 3 slides pulled from benchmark for the demo.
Sam W.: Routing config snippet for ops to review:
```
webhook_url: https://hooks.redwood.example/marketplace
auth_header: 'Bearer <token>'
mapping:
  partner_id: cp_123
  utm_source: cloudpartner
  lead_owner_queue: 'mp-partner-inbound'
verification: true
```
Need token + a sample test payload from partner.
Marta L.: I’ll request token from Security and send partner intro + ask for test payload now. Who can run the E2E test?
Ralph G.: I can run E2E Fri 10am PT. Need partner payload and SFDC test mapping.
Lucy H.: Draft hero copy: "Run production LLM inference with predictable latency and lower per-token cost." CTA: "Get partner trial" — will produce mockups by Thu. Reserving a short testimonial slot.
Jonah S.: I’ll export benchmark charts as PNGs and drop in shared drive for Priya to use in slides.
Sam W.: Ops request — add validation step: partner -> ops-bot validates payload -> returns sample lead id and HTTP 200. Can ops-bot run a smoke check?
ops-bot: Verification scheduled for 1759880400. Please ensure partner test payload is uploaded to the shared drive before that time.
Marta L.: Action items recap:
- Priya: draft webinar deck + coord speakers (due 1759881600)
- Jonah: benchmark draft + charts (due 1759880800)
- Lucy: landing page + mockups (due 1759879200)
- Sam: webhook config + runbook (due 1759879800)
- Ralph: perf artifacts + run E2E test (test 1759880400)
I’ll follow up with partner intro email today.
Sam W.: Small ask — can we include a 1-line partner quote on the landing page (hero)?
Marta L.: Yes, reserve a quote slot. I’ll nudge partner to provide a sentence.
Priya K.: :thumbsup:
